title: Abyssals v0.90.38 — Evolution Renewal
notes: Adds Vigorfume and cultivated three-way Censmoke evolution at level 30; restores item-only Triskit branches from the department store; specialises the three Triskit finals and adds restorative relay tools. Rebalances all 212 damaging stat-changing moves with guaranteed low-power utility, varied proc rates and selected two-stage effects. Countercharge and Countercurrent grant +2 on the first damaging contact hit after entry, plus +1 per damaging super-effective move. Adds Dread Presence and Battle Readiness. Seven refreshed battle designs and matching four-direction follower atlases, with the darker purple Malifume. Removes redundant evolution sale items with one-time save compensation. Preserves earned stats, original Prodigies, existing forms, equipped moves, legal legacy relearning, quests, permanent deaths, package and original signing. Includes the rebuilt offline PWA.
